turns.replyText:
I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you. When you’ve been let down before, it makes choosing the next plant feel risky, and it’s smart to be picky about quality.

A few things about Heirloom that may help ease your mind:

All of our roses are premium own-root plants grown in our Oregon nurseries (not bare root, and not sourced from other growers). Own-root roses are grown on their own natural roots, which makes them longer-lived and more resilient over time.
They are true to variety and virus-free, and shipped in 1-gallon containers with soil, defoliated so they travel well and can put energy into new growth once planted.
We package them to arrive healthy, hydrated, and ready to plant, and every rose is covered by a one-year guarantee.

To make sure we pick the right plant for you, can you tell me a bit more about your situation?

Are you mainly interested in roses, or also open to perennials or bulbs?
What sun conditions do you have (full sun of 6+ hours, or more partial shade)?
Is this for anything specific, like a memorial rose, a hedge, a climber for an arbor, or a container on a patio?

Once I know those details, I can narrow it down to a few high-quality, reliable options that fit exactly what you need so you don’t end up disappointed again.
